title: FTSE 100 LIVE: London stocks at two-week low as Middle East crisis continues to impact oil and gas prices

summary: An adviser to the Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, told state TV that said ships 'should not come to this region'.
summary_zh: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队的一名顾问告诉国家电视台，船只“不应来到该地区”。

title: Why more Britons are carrying mortgages into retirement and how to prepare for it
title_zh: 为什么越来越多的英国人在退休时选择抵押贷款以及如何为此做好准备
summary: Data from UK Finance show that 41,100 new loans were advanced to borrowers over the age of 55 in Q4 2025, up 15.1% year on year.
summary_zh: 英国金融数据显示，2025年第四季度向55岁以上借款人发放了41,100笔新贷款，同比增长15.1%。

title: Drone Strikes Damage Amazon Data Centers in the UAE and Bahrain
title_zh: 无人机袭击损坏了阿联酋和巴林的亚马逊数据中心
summary: Amazon Web Services Inc. said for the first time that drones had “directly struck” two facilities in the UAE.
summary_zh: 亚马逊网络服务公司首次表示，无人机“直接袭击”了阿联酋的两个设施。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures plunge as fresh strikes intensify Iran conflict
title_zh: 今日股市：由于新的罢工加剧伊朗冲突，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货暴跌
summary: The fresh wave of Israeli-led attacks has jolted markets that on Monday mostly managed to shake off the initial shock of the outbreak.
summary_zh: 以色列领导的新一波袭击震动了周一的市场，市场基本上摆脱了疫情爆发的最初冲击。

title: US stocks end mixed, trading volatile amid Iran conflict
title_zh: 美股收盘涨跌互现，伊朗冲突导致交易波动
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks ended narrowly mixed after a volatile session on Monday, with the Dow ticking down marginally, the S&P 500 ending close to flat and the Nasdaq adding just over a third of a percent.Shares dropped early following weekend U.S.
summary_zh: 故事：经过周一的波动，美国股市收盘涨跌互现，道琼斯指数小幅下跌，标准普尔 500 指数收盘接近持平，纳斯达克指数上涨略高于 1/3%。周末后美国股市早盘下跌。

title: Amazon data center unit acquires George Washington University Virginia campus
title_zh: 亚马逊数据中心部门收购乔治华盛顿大学弗吉尼亚校区
summary: Amazon unit Amazon Data Services is acquiring George Washington University's Virginia Science ‌and Technology campus for $427 million, the university said on ‌Monday, part of a rapid expansion of infrastructure to support artificial intelligence.
summary_zh: 乔治华盛顿大学周一表示，亚马逊子公司亚马逊数据服务公司将以 4.27 亿美元收购乔治华盛顿大学弗吉尼亚科学与技术校区，这是支持人工智能的基础设施快速扩张的一部分。
